stage: T022-S2 translation (executable; stage S2 counterexample revisions A-AS2-*)

translation_assumptions.rationale: The analytical backend parses bandwidth in GB/s with 1 GB = 2^30 B and converts to B/ns via bw * 2^30 / 1e9 (common/NetworkFunction.cpp at the pin). The adapter emits the exact finite decimal so the round trip is bit-exact: for B = 64 B/ns it writes 59.604644775390625 GB/s.
translation_assumptions.value: manifest link.bytes_per_ns converted exactly to GB/s

translation_assumptions.rationale: Supersedes A-AS1-DELAY-0 (stage S2 counterexample): the pinned congestion-unaware binary aborts with the EventQueue.cpp:33 assertion 'current_event_list.get_event_time() > current_time' when endpoint-delay is 0 — a zero-delay callback chain schedules an event at the current simulated time. Reproduced on the upstream Ring_reducescatter_4npus example itself with only this key changed, so it is a backend feasibility constraint, not a translation choice. The value 10 mirrors examples/system/native_collectives/Ring_4chunks.json; the per-message endpoint delay it introduces is a declared modeling-assumption difference vs the L0 model (which has no memory-side send delay) — classified in the S3 difference report, never tuned away.

Stage S2 counterexample: without this key Sys.cc:167 defaults local_mem_bw to 0 and PacketBundle::call divides by it (delay = 3 * size / local_mem_bw); the resulting broken event time means no collective ever completes — every rank reports 'unreleased nodes' criticals while the process still exits 0. The value 1600 (GB/s) mirrors the pinned example config and is an upstream-example convention, NOT standard-derived. The memory-side processing delay it adds per packet is a declared modeling-assumption difference vs L0 — classified in S3, never tuned.

The pinned example also carries boost-mode: 0, roofline-enabled: 0 and peak-perf: 900. Measured inert at this pin for pure-collective workloads: the 4-rank probe run produced an identical Wall time (12736 ns) with and without them (roofline_enabled only gates Statistics paths, Statistics.cc:206,284 and Workload.cc:175,240; boost_mode has no consumer outside Sys.cc). They stay omitted so every written knob has a demonstrated effect.
Mirrors the pinned example convention that pairs the split count with the rank count (Ring_4chunks.json declares preferred-dataset-splits: 4 for a 4-NPU ring).
Value of the pinned Ring example config.
Native Ring algorithm on the Ring logical topology — the algorithm/topology pairing the L0 ring identity describes, per the pins doc vertical-slice fit.

Chakra nodes without dependencies all issue at t=0 and would overlap (Workload::issue_dep_free_nodes at the pin); W1 decode steps are serialized in the L0 interpretation, so each rank's ops are chained via data_deps in the generator's fixed order (step-major, layer-minor) to keep the two backends' issue semantics comparable. This is a translation convention, not a standard-derived value.
translation_assumptions.value: sequential chain per rank, ops in generator order

translation_assumptions.rationale: Extends the pinned generator's rank-major global id counter (all_reduce.py increments node_id once per NPU) to multiple ops per rank; ids stay globally unique and replayable.
The only remote-memory backend at the pin is analytical; the pinned congestion-unaware example uses no memory expansion.
